result.title: Closed-Loop Agent Evaluation: Layered Measurement and Self-Calibration
result.summary: Once an agent is live, teams want to know whether it is doing its job, not just whether it throws errors. Yet most evaluation is one-off: a benchmark run, a look at traces, a single score. Its conclusions neither check themselves nor reach the agent. We propose closed-loop evaluation, an evaluation method for deployed agents. It models evaluation as performance estimation under biased raters and censored outcomes, and it requires every level's conclusion to trace back to atomic data and to be computed by versioned rules. The method covers four levels of analysis (span, trace, conversation and engagement), measures along a spine of Execution, Substance, Trajectory and Results, treats Conduct as a constraint throughout, and uses Provenance and Adjudication components to certify the evidence and the evaluators. Evaluator agents generated by an Agent Factory carry these components, each with a domain knowledge pack and an adapter harness. Two loops close the evaluation: an inner loop audits the evidence, rules and metrics themselves, and an outer loop uses per-component regression checks to drive agent improvement. We also give a pipeline that runs this process automatically. Using the business-analysis agent SharpInsight as a case and porting the method to public conversation data, we show how problems differ across levels and how evidence-and-rule judgment is more reliable than holistic scoring (ICC 0.86 vs. 0.81; kappa 0.81 vs. 0.63).

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出面向已部署 agent 的「闭环评估」：将评估建模为有偏评分者与截尾结果下的性能估计，按 span、trace、对话、参与度四层分析，沿 Execution、Substance、Trajectory、Results 主线度量，并用来源追溯与裁决组件认证证据，辅以内外两环审计与回归检查，在业务分析 agent 和公开对话数据上验证证据—规则式判断优于整体打分。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文不涉及视觉或多模态 latent 状态，但其「证据可追溯 + 规则化裁决 + 闭环自校准」的评价框架，可能为核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否被实际使用、以及评估器可靠性提供方法线索，需人工核查其层级划分能否迁移到推理轨迹与证据筛选的评测。
